title: Pinned HTTP dependency blocks installation
root_cause: The regenerated lockfile raised urllib3 from 2.0.7 to 2.2.3 while retaining botocore 1.34.0. On Python 3.12, that botocore release requires urllib3 below 2.1, so pip cannot resolve the pinned requirements.

relevant_evidence.why: pip reports the incompatible urllib3 pin and botocore dependency constraint.
The lockfile pins both conflicting packages.
